terms: fal.ai model output; speridlabs/idol/max lists commercial use as supported. Generated for this project; no third-party likeness, brand or logo requested.

steps.prompt: A single long-haul articulated lorry of a fictional unbranded design: a faded brick-red long-nose conventional tractor unit with a sleeper cab, chrome grille and chrome exhaust stacks, coupled to a long ribbed brushed-aluminium refrigerated box semi-trailer with a refrigeration unit on its front, the trailer perfectly straight and in line with the tractor. Vehicle body only with NO wheels and NO tyres: completely empty wheel arches and bare axle housings, the bare chassis resting low on the ground. Photoreal studio product render of a clean, freshly washed, undamaged vehicle body, physically based materials, crisp panel gaps, high detail. All windows are fully opaque glossy black privacy glass, the interior is not visible at all. Seen from the rear-left side at a 30 degree angle, photographed from far away with a long telephoto lens so there is almost no perspective distortion, the whole vehicle small in the frame with generous empty margin. Single isolated object, the entire object in frame with margin, centered, three-quarter front view from slightly above, even soft studio lighting, no cast shadow, plain light-grey seamless background. No text, no logos, no lettering, no numbers, no brand marks, no emblems anywhere on the object.

postprocess.note: the reference's residual perspective made the trailer a wedge (3.1 m wide at the hitch, 1.8 m at the tail, centreline drifting 1.5 m); vertices with z < 2 (blended to 3.5) were remapped from the fitted edges L(z) = -2.01 + 0.033 z, R(z) = 1.11 + 0.168 z onto a constant 2.95 m box centred at x = 0.05 (tools: /tmp/ao-tools/untaper.mjs)
